description: Templates for generating documents and queries. Multiple templates per type to avoid identical embeddings.
document_templates: {city} is a city in {country}. It is known for being an important urban center in the region.
{city} is located in {country}. It serves as a significant hub for commerce and culture.
The city of {city} can be found in {country}. It is home to a diverse population.
{city} is one of the notable cities in {country}. The city has a rich historical background.
In {country}, the city of {city} stands as a prominent settlement with deep cultural roots.
{city}, situated in {country}, is recognized for its contributions to the national economy.
Among the cities of {country}, {city} is distinguished by its unique character and heritage.
The urban area of {city} in {country} has developed significantly over the decades.
{city} is an established city within {country}, playing a vital role in regional development.
{city} belongs to {country} and is considered one of its important metropolitan areas.
capital_suffix_templates: It serves as the national capital.
The city functions as the capital of the country.
It holds the distinction of being the capital.
large_city_suffix_templates: It is one of the largest cities in the country by population.
The city ranks among the most populous in the nation.
It is a major population center within the country.
query_templates: Which cities can be found in {country}?
What are the urban centers in {country}?
